policy: Conservative review-only candidate mapping for recurring 2029 observances. Candidate discovery uses explicit event identity, category, Hindu tithi and lunar-month constraints. It does not approve rules, select new dates, or modify publication JSON. Combined tithis, regional cases and special exceptions remain manual review.

fieldPolicy.observanceId: Unique occurrence/record ID for this year; the shared ruleId is the cross-year reusable decision logic.
fieldPolicy.muhurtaRule: Untouched; never used as a substitute for ruleId.
fieldPolicy.targetTithiIndex: Explicit zero-based tithi selector derived from the catalogue Hindu tithi; it narrows one occurrence when a rule profile supports multiple tithis.
fieldPolicy.targetTithiIndices: Explicit set for a compound/viddha tithi case; special rules still require their own complete interval logic.
